```{r analysis_da_ds_design, results = "hide"}
# The design and contrasts for DA and DS. Built on a reload too (it takes no
# time), so labelled populations can be tested without rerunning the rest.

daPValToUse <- "p_adj"

# ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 🏷️ Give each condition a code and prepare design matrix
# edgeR and limma only need to know which samples belong together, so they are
# given a code per condition (cond1, cond2, ...) and never the names themselves.
# Condition names can therefore contain anything: Greek letters, subscripts,
# superscripts, +, -, / or spaces.
ei <- metadata(sce)$experiment_info

conditionNames <- levels(droplevels(as.factor(ei$condition)))
conditionCodes <- setNames(paste0("cond", seq_along(conditionNames)), conditionNames)
ei$conditionToTest <- factor(conditionCodes[as.character(ei$condition)], levels = conditionCodes)

cTTForPlots <- contrastsToTest

if (useBatch) {
  # The batch is a term in the model, so a batch difference is not taken for a
  # condition difference. Batches get codes (batch1, ...) for the same reason
  # conditions do: names with odd characters must not reach model.matrix.
  ei$batchToTest <- factor(paste0("batch", as.integer(factor(ei[[batchColumn]]))))
  design <- model.matrix(~0 + conditionToTest + batchToTest, data = ei)
  colnames(design) <- gsub("conditionToTest|batchToTest", "", colnames(design))
} else {
  design <- model.matrix(~0 + conditionToTest, data = ei)
  colnames(design) <- gsub("conditionToTest", "", colnames(design))
}

# ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# ✍️ Create contrasts
message("🧮 Constructing contrasts for edgeR...")

# Split each "A over B" into its two conditions. Both must be conditions from
# the File Data sheet; spacing is tidied the same way as for the contrasts.
tidyConditionNames <- gsub("\\s+", " ", trimws(conditionNames))
contrastConditions <- lapply(contrastsToTest, function(ctr) {
  for (cut in gregexpr("(?= over )", ctr, perl = TRUE)[[1]]) {
    pair <- c(substr(ctr, 1, cut - 1), substr(ctr, cut + 6, nchar(ctr)))
    if (all(pair %in% tidyConditionNames) && pair[1] != pair[2]) return(pair)
  }
  stop("❌ The contrast '", ctr, "' does not match your conditions. ",
       "It should read '<condition> over <condition>', using two different ",
       "conditions from the File Data sheet: ", paste(conditionNames, collapse = ", "))
})

# "A over B" is +1 for A's column of the design and -1 for B's (0 for any
# other column): a positive logFC means higher in A.
contrasts <- lapply(contrastConditions, function(pair) {
  codes <- conditionCodes[match(pair, tidyConditionNames)]
  createContrast((colnames(design) == codes[1]) - (colnames(design) == codes[2]))
})
```

```{r analysis_da_ds, results = "hide", eval = is.null(RDataFolder)}
message("🚀 Starting differential abundance (DA) and differential state (DS) analysis...")

# ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 📊 Differential abundance analysis (DA)
message("📈 Running DA analysis using diffcyt...")
daList <- setNames(lapply(seq_along(contrasts), function(i) {
  res <- diffcyt(
    d_input            = sce,
    design             = design,
    contrast           = contrasts[[i]],
    analysis_type      = "DA",
    method_DA          = "diffcyt-DA-edgeR",
    clustering_to_use  = clusteringMethodToUse,
    min_cells          = 5,
    transform          = FALSE,
    normalize          = TRUE
  )
  as.data.frame(rowData(res$res))
}), cTTForPlots)

# ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 🧬 Differential state analysis (DS)
message("🧪 Running DS analysis using diffcyt...")
sceDS <- sce
if (!any(rowData(sceDS)$marker_class == "state")) {
  message("\u26a0\ufe0f No state markers defined \u2014 treating all markers as state for DS analysis.")
  rowData(sceDS)$marker_class <- "state"
}
ds_formula1 <- createFormula(ei, cols_fixed = "conditionToTest", cols_random = "sample_id")

dsList <- setNames(vector("list", length(contrasts)), cTTForPlots)

for (i in seq_along(contrasts)) {
  res_DS <- diffcyt(
    d_input           = sceDS,
    clustering_to_use = clusteringMethodToUse,
    analysis_type     = "DS",
    method_DS         = "diffcyt-DS-limma",
    design            = design,
    contrast          = contrasts[[i]],
    transform         = FALSE,
    normalize         = TRUE,
    verbose           = FALSE
  )
  dsList[[i]] <- list(res_DS = res_DS, tbl_DS = rowData(res_DS$res))
}

# ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 🔗 Merge clusters and rerun DS
message("🔁 Merging clusters and rerunning DS on merged data...")
mergedID <- paste0(clusteringMethodToUse, "_merged")
mergedTable <- data.frame(
  old_cluster = levels(as.factor(sce[[paste0(mergeBy, knn)]])),
  new_cluster = "all"
)

sceDS <- mergeClusters(
  x     = sceDS,
  k     = clusteringMethodToUse,
  id    = mergedID,
  table = mergedTable
)

ds_formula1 <- createFormula(ei, cols_fixed = "conditionToTest")

for (i in seq_along(contrasts)) {
  res_DS <- diffcyt(
    d_input           = sceDS,
    formula           = ds_formula1,
    clustering_to_use = mergedID,
    analysis_type     = "DS",
    method_DS         = "diffcyt-DS-limma",
    design            = design,
    contrast          = contrasts[[i]],
    transform         = FALSE,
    normalize         = TRUE,
    verbose           = FALSE
  )
  dsList[[paste(cTTForPlots[i], "Merged")]] <- list(
    res_DS = res_DS,
    tbl_DS = rowData(res_DS$res)
  )
}

# ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 🔍 Identify significant DA clusters
message("🔬 Extracting significant DA clusters...")

# Pre-allocate list for efficiency
selectedClustersList <- vector("list", length(contrasts) * 2)
names_list <- character(length(contrasts) * 2)

for (i in seq_along(contrasts)) {
  contrast_conditions <- contrastConditions[[i]]
  da_table <- daList[[i]]
  
  # Filter for complete cases and significant results
  significant_rows <- complete.cases(da_table[c("cluster_id", "logFC", daPValToUse)]) &
                     da_table[[daPValToUse]] <= 0.05
  
  significant_data <- da_table[significant_rows, ]
  
  # Extract clusters by direction
  up_clusters <- as.character(unique(significant_data$cluster_id[significant_data$logFC >= 0]))
  down_clusters <- as.character(unique(significant_data$cluster_id[significant_data$logFC <= 0]))
  
  # Store results
  idx_up <- 2 * i - 1
  idx_down <- 2 * i
  
  selectedClustersList[[idx_up]] <- up_clusters
  selectedClustersList[[idx_down]] <- down_clusters
  
  names_list[idx_up] <- paste0("Contrast ", i, ": ", contrast_conditions[1], " Up")
  names_list[idx_down] <- paste0("Contrast ", i, ": ", contrast_conditions[2], " Up")
}

names(selectedClustersList) <- names_list

# ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 🎨 Assign colours to selected clusters
message("🎨 Assigning colours to selected clusters...")
for (i in seq_along(selectedClustersList)) {
  label <- names(selectedClustersList)[i]
  clusterIDs <- selectedClustersList[[i]]
  sc <- coloursList[[paste0(mergeBy, knn)]][clusterIDs]
  coloursList[[label]] <- sc
}

# 🗺️ Map clusters to colours
message("🗺️ Generating cluster-to-colour mapping list...")
clustersToMapList <- lapply(names(selectedClustersList), function(label) {
  ids <- selectedClustersList[[label]]
  clrs <- coloursList[[label]]
  names(clrs) <- ids
  clrs
})
names(clustersToMapList) <- names(selectedClustersList)

message("✅ DA and DS analysis complete.")

# ── Diagnostic: DA / DS shape (positional indexing, no contrast strings) ──
sce_cluster_levels <- levels(sce$cluster_id)
da_contrast_shapes <- lapply(seq_along(daList), function(i) {
  dl <- daList[[i]]
  cid <- dl$cluster_id
  values <- as.character(cid)
  list(
    index                  = i,
    rows                   = nrow(dl),
    columns                = colnames(dl),
    cluster_id_class       = class(cid)[1],
    cluster_id_nlevels     = if (is.factor(cid)) nlevels(cid) else NA_integer_,
    cluster_id_unique_n    = length(unique(values)),
    levels_match_values    = if (is.factor(cid))
                               setequal(levels(cid), unique(values)) else NA,
    missing_clusters_vs_sce = setdiff(sce_cluster_levels, values),
    extra_clusters_vs_sce   = setdiff(values, sce_cluster_levels),
    p_adj_na_count         = sum(is.na(dl$p_adj))
  )
})
ds_contrast_shapes <- lapply(seq_along(dsList), function(i) {
  entry <- dsList[[i]]
  tbl <- if (is.list(entry) && "tbl_DS" %in% names(entry)) entry$tbl_DS else NULL
  list(
    index        = i,
    has_tbl_DS   = !is.null(tbl),
    rows         = if (!is.null(tbl)) nrow(tbl) else NA_integer_,
    columns      = if (!is.null(tbl)) colnames(tbl) else character(0)
  )
})
MARMOT::run_log_record(log_path, "da_analysis", list(
  method_DA  = "diffcyt-DA-edgeR",
  min_cells  = 5,
  contrasts  = da_contrast_shapes
))
MARMOT::run_log_record(log_path, "ds_analysis", list(
  method_DS  = "diffcyt-DS-limma",
  contrasts  = ds_contrast_shapes
))
MARMOT::run_log_checkpoint(log_path, "analysis_da_ds")
```

```{r analysis_labels, results = "hide"}
# Label, then regenerate. When these results are reloaded and the user has
# named clusters in MARMOT_Cluster_Labels.xlsx (in the first run's results
# folder), the named populations get their own figures and DA/DS. QC,
# clustering and embeddings are not recomputed. Clusters with the same name
# merge; a blank label keeps the cluster; "drop" removes its cells, and
# frequencies are then out of the remaining cells.
labelsFile <- if (!is.null(RDataFolder)) file.path(reloadResultsDir, "MARMOT_Cluster_Labels.xlsx") else ""
clusterLabels <- if (file.exists(labelsFile)) MARMOT::read_cluster_labels(labelsFile, levels(sce$cluster_id)) else NULL
useLabels <- !is.null(clusterLabels)

if (useLabels) {
  message("🏷️ Applying cluster labels from ", basename(labelsFile), "...")
  keepCells <- !is.na(clusterLabels$labels[as.character(sce$cluster_id)])

  # What dropping removed, per sample
  droppedPerSample <- data.frame(
    sample  = levels(sce$sample_id),
    removed = as.integer(table(factor(sce$sample_id[!keepCells], levels = levels(sce$sample_id)))),
    total   = as.integer(table(sce$sample_id))
  )
  droppedPerSample$percent <- round(100 * droppedPerSample$removed / droppedPerSample$total, 1)

  sceLab <- sce[, keepCells]
  eiLab <- metadata(sceLab)$experiment_info
  eiLab$n_cells <- as.integer(table(factor(sceLab$sample_id, levels = eiLab$sample_id)))
  metadata(sceLab)$experiment_info <- eiLab

  # The populations, as a CATALYST clustering of their own, so DA/DS and the
  # CATALYST plots can use them like any clustering
  kept <- clusterLabels$labels[!is.na(clusterLabels$labels)]
  sceLab <- mergeClusters(sceLab, k = clusteringMethodToUse, id = "population",
                          table = data.frame(old_cluster = names(kept), new_cluster = unname(kept)))
  sceLab$population <- factor(unname(kept[as.character(sceLab$cluster_id)]), levels = unique(unname(kept)))

  labDaList <- setNames(lapply(seq_along(contrasts), function(i) {
    res <- diffcyt(d_input = sceLab, design = design, contrast = contrasts[[i]],
                   analysis_type = "DA", method_DA = "diffcyt-DA-edgeR", clustering_to_use = "population",
                   min_cells = 5, transform = FALSE, normalize = TRUE)
    as.data.frame(rowData(res$res))
  }), cTTForPlots)

  sceLabDS <- sceLab
  if (!any(rowData(sceLabDS)$marker_class == "state")) rowData(sceLabDS)$marker_class <- "state"
  labDsList <- setNames(lapply(seq_along(contrasts), function(i) {
    res <- diffcyt(d_input = sceLabDS, design = design, contrast = contrasts[[i]],
                   analysis_type = "DS", method_DS = "diffcyt-DS-limma", clustering_to_use = "population",
                   transform = FALSE, normalize = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)
    as.data.frame(rowData(res$res))
  }), cTTForPlots)

  # What each cluster became, and each sample's share of each population
  # (out of the cells left after dropping)
  popTable <- data.frame(
    Cluster    = names(clusterLabels$labels),
    Population = ifelse(is.na(clusterLabels$labels), "dropped", unname(clusterLabels$labels)),
    Cells      = as.integer(table(factor(sce$cluster_id, levels = names(clusterLabels$labels))))
  )
  perSample <- as.data.frame(table(Sample = sceLab$sample_id, Population = sceLab$population), responseName = "Cells")
  perSample$Percent <- round(100 * perSample$Cells / ave(perSample$Cells, perSample$Sample, FUN = sum), 2)
  perSample$Percent[is.nan(perSample$Percent)] <- NA

  # Save them beside the other Excel files
  labWb <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()
  openxlsx::addWorksheet(labWb, "Populations"); openxlsx::writeData(labWb, "Populations", popTable)
  openxlsx::addWorksheet(labWb, "Per sample"); openxlsx::writeData(labWb, "Per sample", perSample)
  for (nm in names(labDaList)) {
    sheet <- substr(paste("DA", MARMOT::safe_file_name(nm)), 1, 31)
    openxlsx::addWorksheet(labWb, sheet); openxlsx::writeData(labWb, sheet, labDaList[[nm]])
  }
  for (nm in names(labDsList)) {
    sheet <- substr(paste("DS", MARMOT::safe_file_name(nm)), 1, 31)
    openxlsx::addWorksheet(labWb, sheet); openxlsx::writeData(labWb, sheet, labDsList[[nm]])
  }
  openxlsx::addWorksheet(labWb, "Dropped cells"); openxlsx::writeData(labWb, "Dropped cells", droppedPerSample)
  openxlsx::saveWorkbook(labWb, file.path(excelDir, "Labelled_populations_DA_DS.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)

  # A record of the populations this report used, for the Explorer
  MARMOT::save_labelled_populations(RDataFolder, clusterLabels, sce$cluster_id)
}
```

```{r save_results, eval = is.null(RDataFolder), include = FALSE}

message("💾 Saving outputs...")

# Save DA/DS result objects as qs2 — S4 structures can't round-trip through h5ad.
# sceDS is saved without its expression data and embeddings, which are the
# same as those of `sce` in the h5ad; they are put back on loading.
da_ds_save <- list(
  daList = if (exists("daList")) daList else NULL,
  dsList = if (exists("dsList")) dsList else NULL,
  selectedClustersList = if (exists("selectedClustersList")) selectedClustersList else NULL,
  clustersToMapList = if (exists("clustersToMapList")) clustersToMapList else NULL,
  sceDS = if (exists("sceDS")) MARMOT::slim_sce(sceDS) else NULL,
  daPValToUse = if (exists("daPValToUse")) daPValToUse else "p_adj"
)
qs2::qs_save(da_ds_save, file.path(rFilesDir, "da_ds_results.qs2"), nthreads = nCores)
message("Saved (qs2): da_ds_results.qs2")

# Save h5ad — main data store for Shiny app and reproducibility
message("💾 Saving h5ad format...")
MARMOT::save_h5ad_data(rFilesDir, envir = .GlobalEnv)

# Write pipeline_settings.json sidecar so Tauri GUI can reload & lock fields
settings_list <- list(
  clusteringMethodToUse = as.character(clusteringMethodToUse),
  markersToClusterBy    = as.character(markersToClusterBy),
  kValuesIWant          = paste(kValuesIWant, collapse = ", "),
  knn                   = as.character(knn),
  dimRedMethodToUse     = as.character(dimRedMethodToUse),
  markersToDimRedBy     = as.character(markersToDimRedBy),
  runQC                 = as.character(runQC),
  useQC                 = toupper(as.character(useQC)),
  runScGate             = toupper(as.character(runScGate)),
  downsampleTo          = if (is.null(downsampleTo)) "" else as.character(downsampleTo),
  quantileNormaliseAll  = toupper(as.character(quantileNormaliseAll)),
  gimmePDFs             = toupper(as.character(gimmePDFs)),
  greyscalePlots        = toupper(as.character(greyscalePlots)),
  viridisColour         = as.character(viridisColour),
  nCores                = as.character(nCores),
  batchColumn           = if (useBatch) batchColumn else ""
)
jsonlite::write_json(settings_list, file.path(rFilesDir, "pipeline_settings.json"),
                     auto_unbox = TRUE, pretty = TRUE)
message("Saved: pipeline_settings.json")

# Copy metadata Excel into results folder for self-contained archive
file.copy(md_fp, resultsDir, overwrite = TRUE)

# A sheet for naming the clusters: fill in its Label column and run MARMOT
# again from these results to get figures and DA/DS for the named populations
MARMOT::write_cluster_labels_template(
  file.path(resultsDir, "MARMOT_Cluster_Labels.xlsx"),
  clusters = sce$cluster_id,
  expr     = assay(sce, exprsToUse)[featuresToCluster, , drop = FALSE]
)
message("Saved: MARMOT_Cluster_Labels.xlsx")

```{r report_dr_point_size}

# Adaptive point size: 25/sqrt(n) clamped to [0.05, 0.5]
# ~1000 cells → 0.5, ~10k → 0.25, ~50k → 0.11, ~100k → 0.08, ~500k+ → 0.05
n_dr_cells <- nrow(umapDFList[[ifelse(is.null(drCellPerCondition), "All", "Downsampled")]])
dr_point_size <- max(0.05, min(0.5, 25 / sqrt(n_dr_cells)))
```

```{r, label = "report_overview", results = 'asis'}
.n_samples    <- length(unique(sce$sample_id))
.n_conditions <- length(unique(sce$condition))
.n_clusters   <- nlevels(sce$cluster_id)
.plural <- function(n, word) paste0("**", format(n, big.mark = ","), "** ", word, if (n != 1) "s")
cat(.plural(.n_samples, "sample"), " in ", .plural(.n_conditions, "condition"), ", ",
    .plural(ncol(sce), "cell"), " analysed, clustered with **", clusteringMethodToUse,
    "** (k = ", knn, ") into ", .plural(.n_clusters, "cluster"), " and drawn with **",
    dimRedMethodToUse, "**.\n\n", sep = "")
.started <- as.POSIXlt(timeRun, format = "%Y-%m-%d_%H.%M.%S")
cat(sprintf("Started on %d %s %d at %02d:%02d.\n\n", .started$mday, month.name[.started$mon + 1],
            .started$year + 1900, .started$hour, .started$min))
if (!is.null(RDataFolder)) {
  savedWarnings <- MARMOT::read_overview_warnings(RDataFolder)
  if (is.null(savedWarnings)) {
    cat("This report was redrawn from saved results, so warnings from the original run are not shown here.\n\n")
  } else {
    cat("This report was redrawn from saved results; the warnings and notes below are from the original run.\n\n")
    overviewWarnings <- c(savedWarnings, overviewWarnings)
  }
}

# QC warnings: the details are also in the QC tab
if (exists("qc_skip_reason")) {
  overviewWarnings <- c(overviewWarnings, paste0("::: {.callout-warning title='QC Skipped'}\n\n", qc_skip_reason, "\n\n:::\n"))
} else if (runQC %in% c("FlowAI", "PeacoQC") && !useQC && is.null(RDataFolder)) {
  overviewWarnings <- c(overviewWarnings, paste0(
    "::: {.callout-warning title='QC Not Applied'}\n\n",
    "You ran QC using ", runQC, ", but chose **not** to apply it, so the results in this report include every cell. ",
    "The QC tab shows what QC would have removed.\n\n:::\n"))
}
# The first run saves its warnings, so a reload can show them again
if (is.null(RDataFolder)) MARMOT::save_overview_warnings(rFilesDir, overviewWarnings)
cat(overviewWarnings, sep = "\n")

  geom_hline(yintercept = head(overallShare, -1), linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = coloursList[[batchColumn]], labels = MARMOT::greek_label) +
  labs(x = "Cluster", y = "Share of the cluster's cells", fill = "Batch") +
  theme_prism()
```

if(length(kValuesIWant) >= 2) {
  # Subset colData to only clustering columns + sample metadata to avoid
  # prefix collisions (e.g. patient_id collides with PARC prefix "p")
  k_cols <- paste0(mergeBy, kValuesIWant)
  keep_cols <- c(k_cols, "cluster_id", "sample_id")
  keep_cols <- intersect(keep_cols, names(colData(sce)))
  sce_ct <- sce
  colData(sce_ct) <- colData(sce_ct)[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE]
  clustree::clustree(sce_ct, prefix = mergeBy, exprs = "exprsTransformed")
}

```{r, label = "report_clusters_marker_pairs", results = 'asis', fig.height=5, fig.width=5}
runMarkerPairPlots <- ("type" %in% markerType) && ("state" %in% markerType) && !is.null(parse_marker_pairs(smd))
if (runMarkerPairPlots) {
  cat("\n\n")
  cat("### Marker-Pair Scatterplots \n\n")
  es <- as.data.frame(t(assay(sce, "exprsTransformed")))
  es[[mergeBy]] <- sce[[paste0(mergeBy, knn)]]
  set.seed(2)
  if (!is.null(downsampleTo)) {
    if (nrow(es) > downsampleTo) {
      es <- es[sample(rownames(es), downsampleTo),]
    }
  }
  esQN <- as.data.frame(t(assay(sce, "exprsQuantNorm")))
  esQN[[mergeBy]] <- sce[[paste0(mergeBy, knn)]]
  if (!is.null(downsampleTo)) {
    if (nrow(esQN) > downsampleTo) {
      esQN <- esQN[sample(rownames(esQN), downsampleTo),]
    }
  }
  
  mp <- parse_marker_pairs(smd)
  markerPairs <- mp$pairs
  markerPairTypes <- mp$types
  markerPairsList <- setNames(lapply(markerPairTypes, function(x) {
    toPlot <- markerPairs[grep(paste0("^", x), markerPairs)]
    plots <- setNames(lapply(toPlot, function(y) {
      markersToPlot <- strsplit(strsplit(y, "\\: ")[[1]][[2]], " ")[[1]]
      markersToPlot <- dplyr::coalesce(MARMOT::match_names(markersToPlot, names(es))$matched, markersToPlot)
      clr_vals <- coloursList[[paste0(mergeBy, knn)]]
      if (!quantileNormaliseAll) {
        median_es <- do.call(rbind, lapply(unique(es[[mergeBy]]), function(cl) {
          data.frame(V1 = cl, x = median(es[[markersToPlot[1]]][es[[mergeBy]] == cl]),
                     y = median(es[[markersToPlot[2]]][es[[mergeBy]] == cl]))
        }))
        colnames(median_es)[1] <- mergeBy
        q1 <- ggplot(es, aes(x = .data[[markersToPlot[1]]], y = .data[[markersToPlot[2]]], color = .data[[mergeBy]])) +
          geom_point(size = 0.001) +
          geom_label_repel(data = median_es, aes(x = x, y = y, label = .data[[mergeBy]], fill = .data[[mergeBy]]),
                           colour = "black", show.legend = FALSE, size = 4) +
          scale_color_manual(values = clr_vals) +
          scale_fill_manual(values = clr_vals) +
          theme_prism() +
          theme(legend.position = "hide") +
          labs(x = MARMOT::marker_label(markersToPlot[1], markerDisplay), y = MARMOT::marker_label(markersToPlot[2], markerDisplay)) +
          ggtitle(MARMOT::greek_label(paste0(x, "\nTransformed")))
      }
      median_esQN <- do.call(rbind, lapply(unique(esQN[[mergeBy]]), function(cl) {
        data.frame(V1 = cl, x = median(esQN[[markersToPlot[1]]][esQN[[mergeBy]] == cl]),
                   y = median(esQN[[markersToPlot[2]]][esQN[[mergeBy]] == cl]))
      }))
      colnames(median_esQN)[1] <- mergeBy
      p1 <- ggplot(esQN, aes(x = .data[[markersToPlot[1]]], y = .data[[markersToPlot[2]]], color = .data[[mergeBy]])) +
        geom_point(size = 0.001) +
        geom_label_repel(data = median_esQN, aes(x = x, y = y, label = .data[[mergeBy]], fill = .data[[mergeBy]]),
                         colour = "black", show.legend = FALSE, size = 4) +
        scale_color_manual(values = clr_vals) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = clr_vals) +
        theme_prism() +
        theme(legend.position = "hide") +
        labs(x = MARMOT::marker_label(markersToPlot[1], markerDisplay), y = MARMOT::marker_label(markersToPlot[2], markerDisplay)) +
        ggtitle(MARMOT::greek_label(paste0(x, "\nTransformed & QN")))
      if (!quantileNormaliseAll) {
        return(list(q1, p1))
      } else {
        return(list(p1))
      }
    }), toPlot)
  }), markerPairTypes)
  
  cat(":::::::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n")
  lapply(names(markerPairsList), function(x) {
    cat("####", x, " \n\n")
    cat(":::::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n")
    lapply(names(markerPairsList[[x]]), function(y) {
      cat("#####", y, " \n\n")
      print(markerPairsList[[x]][[y]][[1]])
      if (length(markerPairsList[[x]][[y]]) == 2)
        print(markerPairsList[[x]][[y]][[2]])
      cat("\n\n")
    })
    cat("::::::\n\n")
    cat("\n\n")
  })
  cat("::::::::\n\n")
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

```{r, label = "report_clusters_heatmap_type_state", results = 'asis', fig.height=max(6, ceiling(length(numbersOfClusters)/2.5)), fig.width=max(8, ceiling(length(useMarkers)/2.5))}
heatmapsList <- list()
if("type" %in% markerType && "state" %in% markerType) {
  cat("##### Type Markers Only \n\n")
  pET <- plotExprHeatmap(
    x = sce,
    assay = exprsToUse,
    features = "type",
    by = "cluster_id",
    k = clusteringMethodToUse,
    bars = TRUE,
    perc = TRUE,
    col_clust = FALSE,
    hm_pal = hmPalToUse,
    k_pal = coloursList[[paste0(mergeBy, knn)]]
    )
  pET <- MARMOT::greek_heatmap(pET, markerDisplay)
  heatmapsList[["Type"]] <- pET
  ComplexHeatmap::draw(pET, merge_legend = TRUE)
  pETdf <- pET@matrix[row_order(pET),]
  topLineageTable <- data.frame(
    "Cluster" = paste("Cluster", rownames(pETdf))
  )
  topLineageTable$Top_Lineage_Markers <- NA
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(topLineageTable))) {
    row_vals <- pETdf[i,]; topLineageTable$Top_Lineage_Markers[i] <- paste(names(head(sort(row_vals[row_vals > 0.4], decreasing = TRUE), n = 2)), collapse = " ")
  }
  topLineageTable <- topLineageTable[mixedorder(topLineageTable$Cluster), ]
  print(
    htmltools::tagList(
      DT::datatable(
        data = topLineageTable, 
        rownames = FALSE, 
        colnames = c("Cluster", "Top 2 Type Markers"), 
        filter = "top", 
        width = 800, 
        caption = "Top Lineage Markers have to have mean expression > 0.4 to be included, so you may only see 1 marker")
      )
    )
  cat("\n\n")
  
  cat("##### State Markers Only \n\n")
  pES <- plotExprHeatmap(
    x = sce, 
    features = "state", 
    by = "cluster_id", 
    k = clusteringMethodToUse,
    bars = TRUE, 
    perc = TRUE, 
    col_clust = FALSE, 
    hm_pal = hmPalToUse,
    k_pal = coloursList[[paste0(mergeBy, knn)]]
    )
  pES <- MARMOT::greek_heatmap(pES, markerDisplay)
  heatmapsList[["State"]] <- pES
  ComplexHeatmap::draw(pES, merge_legend = TRUE)
  pESdf <- pES@matrix[row_order(pES),]
  topStateTable <- data.frame(
    "Cluster" = paste("Cluster", rownames(pESdf))
  )
  topStateTable$Top_State_Markers <- NA
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(topStateTable))) {
    topStateTable$Top_State_Markers[i] <- paste(names(head(sort(pESdf[i,], decreasing = TRUE), n = 3)), collapse = " ")
    topStateTable$Bottom_State_Markers[i] <- paste(names(tail(sort(pESdf[i,], decreasing = TRUE), n = 3)), collapse = " ")
  }
  topStateTable <- topStateTable[mixedorder(topStateTable$Cluster), ]
  print(
    htmltools::tagList(
      DT::datatable(
        data = topStateTable, 
        rownames = FALSE, 
        colnames = c("Cluster", "Top 3 State Markers", "Bottom 3 State Markers"), 
        filter = "top", 
        width = 800
        )
      )
    )
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

selectedBarplotList <- setNames(lapply(seq_along(dfList), function(i) {
  cat("\n\n#### DA:", names(dfList)[i], "\n\n")
  if (nrow(dfList[[i]]) >= 1) {
    g <- ggplot(dfList[[i]], aes(x = .data[["sample_id"]], y = .data[["Freq"]], fill = .data[["cluster_id"]]))
    g <- g + geom_bar(stat = "identity")
    g <- g + facet_grid(~condition, scales = "free", space = "free", labeller = MARMOT::label_greek)
    g <- g + scale_fill_manual(values = coloursList[[names(selectedClustersList)[[i]]]])
    g <- g + ggtitle(MARMOT::greek_label(names(dfList)[i]))
    g <- g + scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) + scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), labels = seq(0, 100, 25), limits = c(0, 100))
    g <- g + theme_prism(axis_text_angle = 90)
    g <- g + theme(panel.border = element_blank(), panel.spacing.x = unit(1, "lines"))
    g <- g + ylab("Proportion [%]") + xlab("Sample ID")
    print(g)
    return(list("g" = g, "stem" = pdf_name_stem(names(dfList)[[i]])))
  } else {
    cat("There are no DA clusters in this group.\n")
  }
  cat("\n\n")
}), names(dfList))

## From CATALYST plotFreqHeatmap function

ctsList <- lapply(names(daList), function(da) { strsplit(da, " over ")[[1]] }) |> setNames(names(daList))

clusterPvalues <- lapply(levels(kids), function(k) {
  pvals <- lapply(names(daList), function(da) { daList[[da]]$p_adj[daList[[da]]$cluster_id == k] }) |> setNames(names(daList)) |> unlist()
  if(any(is.na(pvals))) {pvals[is.na(pvals)] <- 1}
  y_max <- max(clusterBoxPlotsDFMelt$value)
  spacing <- (y_max - min(clusterBoxPlotsDFMelt$value)) * 0.2
  y_positions <- y_max + (1:length(ctsList)) * spacing
  pval_df <- data.frame(
    group1 = sapply(ctsList, `[`, 1),
    group2 = sapply(ctsList, `[`, 2),
    p = pvals,
    y.position = y_positions
  )
  pval_df <- add_significance(pval_df, p.col = "p", output.col = "p.signif")
  
  pval_df
}) |> setNames(levels(kids))
maxY <- lapply(seq_along(clusterPvalues), function(i) {clusterPvalues[[i]]$y.position}) |> unlist() |> max()

clusterBoxplotList <- lapply(levels(kids), function(k) {
  ctp <- as.character(k)
  ggplot(clusterBoxPlotsDF, aes(x = .data[["condition"]], y = .data[[ctp]])) + 
    ## geom_vline(xintercept = (seq_along(condLevels)+0.5)[-length(condLevels)], linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.6) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(min(clusterBoxPlotsDFMelt$value), maxY)) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(fill = condition), alpha = 0.2, show.legend = FALSE, outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_beeswarm(aes(fill = condition), pch = 21, size = 3, stroke = 0.3, cex = 2, corral = "random", corral.width = 0.9) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = coloursList$condition, labels = MARMOT::greek_label) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = MARMOT::greek_label) +
    stat_pvalue_manual(clusterPvalues[[ctp]], label = "p.signif", tip.length = 0, hide.ns = TRUE, label.size = 9, bracket.size = 0.8, bracket.shorten = 0.1, bracket.nudge.y = -0.1) +
    theme_prism(axis_text_angle = 45) +
    ggtitle(paste("Cluster", ctp)) +
    theme(legend.position = "hide", axis.title = element_blank())
})
ylab <- textGrob("Normalised Frequency", rot = 90, gp = gpar(fontface = "bold", fontsize = 16))
xlab <- textGrob("Condition", gp = gpar(fontface = "bold", fontsize = 16))
grid.arrange(grobs = clusterBoxplotList, ncol = nColsToPlot, left = ylab, bottom = xlab)
```

```{r, label = "report_dr_cells_shown", results = 'asis'}
# How many cells the maps show from each condition, as set in 'Cells per
# condition in UMAPs etc.' (the cells shown from each sample of a condition).
# Counted from the maps themselves, so an excluded sample shows in the totals.
if (!is.null(drCellPerCondition)) {
  shownDF <- umapDFList$Downsampled
  cellsShown <- vapply(names(drCellPerCondition), function(cond) {
    inCond <- as.character(shownDF$condition) == cond
    nSamples <- length(unique(shownDF$sample_id[inCond]))
    sprintf("up to %s cells from each %s sample (%d sample%s, %s cells)",
            format(floor(drCellPerCondition[[cond]]), big.mark = ","), cond,
            nSamples, if (nSamples == 1) "" else "s", format(sum(inCond), big.mark = ","))
  }, character(1))
  cat("The maps show ", paste(cellsShown, collapse = "; "),
      ", as set in 'Cells per condition in UMAPs etc.'.\n\n", sep = "")
}

```{r, label = "report_dr_clusters_labelled", fig.cap = paste0("The ", dimRedMethodToUse, " embedding coloured by cluster, with cluster labels."), fig.height=6, fig.width=7}
if (is.null(drCellPerCondition)) {
  umapsDFToPlot <- "All"
} else {
  umapsDFToPlot <- "Downsampled"
}
# ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 💾 Save the plotted cells, so these plots can be redrawn anywhere
# One Excel file with four sheets: Read me, Cells, Expression (arcsinh), Colours.

# Cells: the plotting table, plus the FCS file and event each cell came from
cellsToSave <- as.data.frame(umapDFList[[umapsDFToPlot]])
cellsToSave$file_name <- md$file_name[match(cellsToSave$sample_id, md$sample_id)]
cellsToSave$event_number <- MARMOT::event_numbers(sce)[cellsToSave$sce_idx]
cellsToSave <- dplyr::relocate(cellsToSave, file_name, event_number, .after = sample_id)

# Expression (arcsinh): the same cells in the same order, before the 0 to 1 scaling
arcsinhToSave <- cbind(
  cellsToSave[, c("sample_id", "file_name", "event_number", "sce_idx")],
  t(assay(sce, "exprsTransformed"))[cellsToSave$sce_idx, , drop = FALSE]
)

# Colours: every colour the report uses for the columns of the Cells sheet
coloursToSave <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(intersect(names(coloursList), names(cellsToSave)), function(v) {
  data.frame(used_for = v, value = names(coloursList[[v]]), colour = unname(coloursList[[v]]))
}))
# ... and the marker scale, unless it is "Lucky", which is random every time
if (viridisColour != "Lucky") {
  markerScale <- get_palette_colours(viridisColour)
  coloursToSave <- dplyr::bind_rows(coloursToSave, data.frame(
    used_for = "marker scale, low to high", value = as.character(seq_along(markerScale)), colour = markerScale
  ))
}

MARMOT::write_coordinates_file(
  file    = file.path(excelDir, paste0(dimRedMethodToUse, "_Coordinates.xlsx")),
  cells   = cellsToSave,
  arcsinh = arcsinhToSave,
  colours = coloursToSave,
  about   = list(
    "MARMOT version"      = as.character(packageVersion("MARMOT")),
    "Dimension reduction" = dimRedMethodToUse,
    "Clustering"          = clusteringMethodToUse,
    "Cells in this file"  = if (is.null(drCellPerCondition)) "All cells of the analysis" else "A sample of the cells of each condition, as plotted in the report",
    "Marker colour scale" = viridisColour
  )
)
dr1a <- plotUMAPNice(
  df = as.data.frame(umapDFList[[umapsDFToPlot]]),
  colour_by = "cluster_id",
  show_density = FALSE,
  alpha = 0.9,
  show_cluster_labels = TRUE,
  show_grids = FALSE,
  text_size = 14
  ) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = dr_legend_dot, alpha = 1)))
dr1a
```

```{r, label = "report_dr_per_marker_build", results = 'asis', include = FALSE}
UMAPList <- setNames(lapply(c("With", "Without"), function(yn) {
  var <- switch(
    yn,
    "With" = TRUE,
    "Without" = FALSE
  )
  l1 <- setNames(lapply(useMarkers, function(marker) {
    m1 <- plotUMAPNice(
      df = as.data.frame(umapDFList[[umapsDFToPlot]]),
      colour_by = marker,
      name = "Normalised\nExpression\n",
      show_cluster_labels = var
      )
    m1 <- m1 + ggtitle(MARMOT::marker_label(marker, markerDisplay)) + theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"), axis.title = element_blank())
    m1
  }), useMarkers)
  l1[["legend"]] <- cowplot::get_legend(l1[[1]])
  for (marker in useMarkers) {
    l1[[marker]] <- l1[[marker]] + theme(legend.position = "hide")
  }
  return(l1)
}), c("With Labels", "Without Labels"))

```{r, label = "report_scgate_models", results = 'asis', fig.height=6, fig.width=6, eval = show_scgate}
invisible(lapply(names(scgate_models), function(mpt) {
  cat("####", mpt, "\n\n")
  y <- gsub("[ -]", "", mpt)
  m1 <- scgate_models[[mpt]][[1]]
  m2 <- scgate_models[[mpt]][[2]]
  if (!m1 %in% rownames(sce)) {
    hit <- stats::na.omit(MARMOT::match_names(m1, rownames(sce))$matched)
    if (length(hit) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))
    m1 <- hit[[1]]
  }
  if (!m2 %in% rownames(sce)) {
    hit <- stats::na.omit(MARMOT::match_names(m2, rownames(sce))$matched)
    if (length(hit) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))
    m2 <- hit[[1]]
  }

  dr_theme <- theme_prism() + theme(
    axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_blank(), legend.position = "none",
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1.5)
  )

  # Plot 1: DimPlot — is this cell type?
  p1 <- plotUMAPNice(
    df = umapDFList[[umapsDFToPlot]],
    colour_by = paste0("is_", y),
    show_density = FALSE,
    alpha = 1
  ) + ggtitle(MARMOT::greek_label(paste0("Are ", mpt, "?"))) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
  print(p1)
  cat("\n\n")

  # Plot 2: FeaturePlot — UCell score
  ucell_col <- paste0(mpt, "_UCell")
  p2 <- ggplot(umapDFList[[umapsDFToPlot]], aes(x = .data[["x"]], y = .data[["y"]], colour = .data[[ucell_col]])) +
    geom_point(size = dr_point_size, shape = 16) +
    scale_colour_gradientn(colours = hcl.colors(64, "mako")) +
    labs(
      x = paste(dimRedMethodToUse, "dim 1"),
      y = paste(dimRedMethodToUse, "dim 2"),
      title = paste0(mpt, " UCell Score")
    ) + dr_theme
  print(p2)
  cat("\n\n")

  # Plot 3: Joint density — ks::kde weighted scatter
  df_joint <- umapDFList[[umapsDFToPlot]]
  emb_mat <- as.matrix(df_joint[, c("x", "y")])
  w_joint <- rep(0, nrow(df_joint))
  for (mk in c(m1, m2)) {
    if (mk %in% colnames(df_joint)) {
      v <- as.numeric(df_joint[[mk]])
      v[is.na(v)] <- 0
      w_joint <- w_joint + v
    }
  }
  if (sum(w_joint) > 0) {
    w_norm <- w_joint / sum(w_joint) * length(w_joint)
    dens <- ks::kde(emb_mat, w = w_norm, eval.points = emb_mat)
    df_joint$density <- dens$estimate
  } else {
    df_joint$density <- 0
  }
  df_joint <- df_joint[order(df_joint$density), ]

  p3 <- ggplot(df_joint, aes(x = .data[["x"]], y = .data[["y"]], colour = .data[["density"]])) +
    geom_point(size = dr_point_size, alpha = 0.7, shape = 16) +
    scale_colour_gradientn(colours = get_palette_colours(viridisColour)) +
    ggtitle(MARMOT::greek_label(paste0(MARMOT::marker_display(m1, markerDisplay), " + ", MARMOT::marker_display(m2, markerDisplay), " density"))) +
    coord_fixed() + dr_theme +
    labs(x = paste(dimRedMethodToUse, "dim 1"),
         y = paste(dimRedMethodToUse, "dim 2"),
         colour = "Density")
  print(p3)
  cat("\n\n")
}))
cat("::::::::\n\n")   # closes the tab set opened in report_scgate_header
```

## DA / DS

:::::::::: panel-tabset
### DA

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="About Differential Abundance"}

Differential abundance of clusters between conditions. Each cluster was tested individually between the two groups specified in each test, e.g., cluster 1 in KO vs WT. Each test gives a log2 fold change, and p-values. Below is the results for each test specified in the metadata. The heatmap shows the expression of each cluster per sample, in order of p-value (most statistically differentially abundant at the top). If you have entered more than one test, then the heatmaps will show the same data but the clusters will be in different orders.

To the right of the heatmap are two annotations. The first is red or blue, and denotes the log2 fold change of that cluster. The second is the p-value, and is either green (adjusted p-value \< 0.05) or grey. The results of this heatmap are the same as under the `Heatmap -> Sample Per Cluster` but with the rows re-ordered and with the log2fc and p-values.
:::

```{r, label = "report_da_table_library", include = FALSE}
htmltools::tagList(DT::datatable(data.frame(x = 1)))
```

:::::::: panel-tabset

```{r, label = "report_da_results", fig.height=6, fig.width=13, results='asis'}
daResultsList <- setNames(lapply(names(daList), function(cont) {
  cat("\n\n")
  cat("####", cont, "Top 20 \n\n")
  pDH <- plotDiffHeatmap(sce, daList[[cont]], normalize = TRUE, all = TRUE, top_n = 20, col_anno = conditions)
  pDH <- apply_anno_colours(pDH, conditions, coloursList)
  pDH <- MARMOT::greek_heatmap(pDH, markerDisplay)
  print(pDH)
  cat("\n\n")
  cx <- cont |> gsub(pattern = " ", replacement = "_", x = _) |> gsub(pattern = "-", replacement = "_", x = _) |> gsub(pattern = "\\+", replacement = ".", x = _) |> gsub(pattern = "\\/", replacement = ".", x = _)
  ## daDF <- as.data.frame(daList[[cont]][which(daList[[cont]][[daPValToUse]] <= 0.05), c("cluster_id", "logFC", "p_val", "p_adj")])
  daDF <- as.data.frame(daList[[cont]][, c("cluster_id", "logFC", "p_val", "p_adj")])
  daDF <- daDF[order(daDF[[daPValToUse]]),]
  print(htmltools::tagList(
    datatable(daDF, rownames = FALSE, width = "600px") |>
      formatSignif(c("p_val", "p_adj", "logFC"), digits = 3) |>
      formatStyle(columns = c("p_val", "p_adj"), color = styleInterval(cuts = 0.05, values = c("green", "black")), fontWeight = "bold") |>
      formatStyle(columns = "logFC", color = styleInterval(cuts = 0, values = c("blue", "darkorange")), fontWeight = "bold")
  ))
  cat("\n\n")
  openxlsx::write.xlsx(x = as.data.frame(daList[[cont]]), file = file.path(excelDir, paste0(MARMOT::safe_file_name(cont), "_DA_Results.xlsx")))
  return(list("pDH" = pDH, "cx" = cx, "daDF" = daDF))
}), names(daList))

### DS

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="About Differential State"}

Differential state (DS) analysis tests whether the expression of individual markers within each cluster differs between conditions. Unlike DA (which tests cluster abundance), DS tests for changes in marker expression levels within each cluster.
:::

:::::::: panel-tabset

```{r, label = "report_ds_results", results = 'asis', fig.height=12, fig.width=10}
dsPThreshToUse <- 0.05

# Everything the report shows for one DS test: the Excel file, the markers up
# in each group, the heatmap and the full table. merged = TRUE is for the
# tests run with all clusters merged into one.
show_ds_results <- function(cont, merged = FALSE) {
  groups <- strsplit(sub(" Merged$", "", cont), split = " over ")[[1]]

  cat("\n\n")
  cat("####", cont, "\n\n")

  openxlsx::write.xlsx(x = as.data.frame(dsList[[cont]]$tbl_DS), file = file.path(excelDir, paste0(MARMOT::safe_file_name(cont), if (merged) "_DS_Merged_Results.xlsx" else "_DS_Full_Results.xlsx")))

  dsUp_tbl <- sort(table(dsList[[cont]]$tbl_DS$marker_id[which(dsList[[cont]]$tbl_DS[[daPValToUse]] <= dsPThreshToUse & dsList[[cont]]$tbl_DS$logFC >= 0)]), decreasing = TRUE); dsUp <- data.frame(dsUp_tbl[dsUp_tbl >= 1])
  dsDown_tbl <- sort(table(dsList[[cont]]$tbl_DS$marker_id[which(dsList[[cont]]$tbl_DS[[daPValToUse]] <= dsPThreshToUse & dsList[[cont]]$tbl_DS$logFC <= 0)]), decreasing = TRUE); dsDown <- data.frame(dsDown_tbl[dsDown_tbl >= 1])

  if (nrow(dsUp) == 1) {
    dsUp <- data.frame("Marker" = rownames(dsUp), "Number of clusters" = dsUp[1,])
  }
  if (nrow(dsDown) == 1) {
    dsDown <- data.frame("Marker" = rownames(dsDown), "Number of clusters" = dsDown[1,])
  }

  cat("**Markers up in", groups[1], "**\n\n")
  if (nrow(dsUp) >= 1) {
    print(
      kable(
        x = dsUp,
        col.names = c("Marker", "Number of clusters")) |>
        kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE, position = "left")
    )
    cat("\n\n")
  } else {
    cat("There are no up-regulated markers in", groups[1], "\n\n")
  }

  cat("**Markers up in", groups[2], "**\n\n")
  if (nrow(dsDown) >= 1) {
    print(
      kable(
        x = dsDown,
        col.names = c("Marker", "Number of clusters")) |>
        kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE, position = "left")
    )
    cat("\n\n")
  } else {
    cat("There are no up-regulated markers in", groups[2], "\n\n")
  }

  cat("**Heatmap**\n\n")
  pDH <- plotDiffHeatmap(if (merged) sceDS else sce, dsList[[cont]]$tbl_DS, normalize = TRUE, all = TRUE, fdr = dsPThreshToUse, col_anno = conditions, hm_pal = hmPalToUse)
  pDH <- apply_anno_colours(pDH, conditions, coloursList)
  pDH <- MARMOT::greek_heatmap(pDH, markerDisplay)
  print(pDH)
  cat("\n\n")
  cat("**Full Results**\n\n")
  if (!merged) {
    cat("This table shows the log2FC and p-values of each marker per cluster in", cont, "\n\n")
  }
  cat("Positive log2fc means the marker was higher in", groups[1], "in a given cluster. \n\n")
  cat("Negative log2fc means the marker was higher in", groups[2], "in a given cluster. \n\n")

  dsTab1 <- as.data.frame(dsList[[cont]]$tbl_DS[, c("cluster_id", "marker_id", "logFC", "p_val", "p_adj")])
  dsTab1 <- dsTab1[order(dsTab1$p_val), ]
  print(
    htmltools::tagList(DT::datatable(
      data = dsTab1,
      rownames = FALSE,
      width = "700px"
      ) |>
        DT::formatSignif(c("logFC", "p_val", "p_adj"), digits = 3) |>
        DT::formatStyle("logFC", color = styleInterval(cuts = 0, values = c("blue", "darkorange")), fontWeight = "bold") |>
        DT::formatStyle(c("p_val", "p_adj"), color = styleInterval(cuts = 0.05, values = c("green", "black")),fontWeight = "bold")
    )
  )
  cat("\n\n")
  list("pDH" = pDH, "dsTab1" = dsTab1)
}

dsContrasts <- names(dsList)[grep("Merged", names(dsList), invert = TRUE)]

heatmapClustersList <- list()
for (i in seq_along(selectedClustersList)) {
  if (length(selectedClustersList[[i]]) >= 2) {

    cat("####", names(selectedClustersList)[i], "\n\n")
    cl <- selectedClustersList[[i]]
    x1 <- filterSCE(.da_hm$x, cluster_id %in% cl, k = clusteringMethodToUse)

    fq <- round(ns/sum(ns) * 100, 2)
    txt <- sprintf("%s%%(%s)", fq, names(fq))
    txt <- txt[which(gsub(".*\\(|\\).*", "", txt) %in% names(ns2))]
    foo <- row_anno_text(txt, just = "center", gp = gpar(fontsize = 8), location = unit(0.5, "npc"))
    right_anno <- rowAnnotation(n_cells = row_anno_barplot(x = as.matrix(ns2), width = unit(2, "cm"), gp = gpar(fill = "grey", col = "white"), border = FALSE, axis = TRUE, bar_width = 0.8), foo = foo)

    left_anno <- CATALYST:::.anno_clusters(x1, "cluster_id", NULL, coloursList[[names(selectedClustersList)[[i]]]], NULL)

    z1 <- .da_hm$z[selectedClustersList[[i]], ]
    h1 <- Heatmap(
      matrix = z1,
      name = paste0("median scaled\nexpression"),
      col = hmPalToUse,
      cluster_rows = TRUE,
      cluster_columns = FALSE,
      show_row_dend = TRUE,
      show_column_dend = TRUE,
      show_row_names = FALSE,
      row_names_side = "left",
      left_annotation = left_anno,
      right_annotation = right_anno,
      rect_gp = gpar(col = "white"),
      heatmap_legend_param = .da_hm$lgd_aes
    )
    h1 <- MARMOT::greek_heatmap(h1, markerDisplay)
    print(h1)
    heatmapClustersList[[i]] <- h1
    if (gimmePDFs) {
      pdf(file = file.path(pdfDir, MARMOT::safe_file_name(paste0(pdf_name_stem(names(selectedClustersList)[[i]]), "_heatmaps.pdf"))), width = 10, height = ceiling(length(cl)*0.5)+1)
      print(h1)
      dev.off()
    }
    cat("\n\n")
  } else {
    cat("####", names(selectedClustersList)[i], "\n\n")
    cat("There is only one (or zero) cluster(s) in this group, and the heatmaps currently do not support a single cluster. Sorry!")
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}

### `r paste(dimRedMethodToUse)` of DA Clusters

:::::::: panel-tabset

#### All Cells

```{r, label = "report_da_dr", fig.height=5, fig.width=5, results = 'asis'}
# The embedding with the DA clusters of group i picked out in colour and the
# other cells in grey. by_condition = TRUE draws one panel per condition, all
# on the same axes.
plot_da_clusters <- function(i, by_condition = FALSE) {
  clustersToMap <- names(clustersToMapList[[i]])
  cTM <- clustersToMapList[[i]]
  umapDF <- umapDFList[[umapsDFToPlot]]
  umapDF2 <- umapDF[umapDF[["cluster_id"]] %in% clustersToMap,]
  umapDF2[["cluster_id"]] <- droplevels(umapDF2[["cluster_id"]])
  umapDF3 <- umapDF[!umapDF[["cluster_id"]] %in% clustersToMap, ]

  ## Get the mean x/y coordinate for each cluster so we can add labels manually 
  cluster_centre <- umapDF2 |>
  dplyr::group_by(cluster_id) |>
  dplyr::summarize(center_x = mean(x), center_y = mean(y))

  gp <- ggplot(umapDF, aes(x = .data[["x"]], y = .data[["y"]], colour = .data[["cluster_id"]]))

  gp <- gp + geom_point(data = umapDF3, size = dr_point_size, colour = "grey75", alpha = 0.3, shape = 16, show.legend = FALSE)
  gp <- gp + geom_point(data = umapDF2, size = dr_point_size * 1.5, alpha = 0.95)
  gp <- gp + geom_label_repel(data = cluster_centre, aes(x = center_x, y = center_y, label = cluster_id, fill = cluster_id), size = 4, colour = "black", show.legend = FALSE)
  gp <- gp + scale_color_manual(values = cTM, breaks = levels(as.factor(umapDF2[["cluster_id"]])))
  gp <- gp + scale_fill_manual(values = cTM, breaks = levels(as.factor(umapDF2[["cluster_id"]])))
  if (by_condition) {
    gp <- gp + ylim(min(umapDF$y[!is.na(umapDF$y)])-1, max(umapDF$y[!is.na(umapDF$y)])+1)
    gp <- gp + xlim(min(umapDF$x[!is.na(umapDF$x)])-1, max(umapDF$x[!is.na(umapDF$x)])+1)
  }
  gp <- gp + labs(x = paste(dimRedMethodToUse, "dim 1"), y = paste(dimRedMethodToUse, "dim 2"))
  if (by_condition) {
    gp <- gp + facet_wrap(~ condition, ncol = 2, labeller = MARMOT::label_greek)
  }
  gp <- gp + ggtitle(MARMOT::greek_label(names(clustersToMapList)[i]))
  gp <- gp + coord_fixed() +
    theme_prism() +
    theme(
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_blank(),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
      panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1.5),
      legend.position = "hide")
  gp + guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = dr_legend_dot, alpha = 1)))
}

DRSelectedClusters <- setNames(lapply(seq_along(clustersToMapList), function(i) {
  gp <- plot_da_clusters(i)
  print(gp)
  return(list("gp" = gp, "stem" = pdf_name_stem(names(clustersToMapList)[[i]])))
}), names(clustersToMapList))
```

cat("## Labelled populations\n\n")
cat("These are the populations named in **MARMOT_Cluster_Labels.xlsx**: ", nlevels(sceLab$population),
    " populations from ", nlevels(sce$cluster_id), " clusters. QC, clustering and the embeddings are ",
    "those of the original run; frequencies and DA/DS were recalculated for the populations. ",
    "The full tables are in Excel_Files/Labelled_populations_DA_DS.xlsx.\n\n", sep = "")
if (length(clusterLabels$notes)) cat(paste0("- ", clusterLabels$notes, collapse = "\n"), "\n\n")
if (length(clusterLabels$dropped)) {
  cat("::: {.callout-warning title='Clusters dropped'}\n\n",
      "Cluster(s) ", paste(clusterLabels$dropped, collapse = ", "), " were dropped, so frequencies below are ",
      "out of the remaining cells. Cells this removed from each sample:\n\n", sep = "")
  print(knitr::kable(setNames(droppedPerSample, c("Sample", "Cells removed", "Cells in sample", "% removed"))))
  cat("\n\n:::\n\n")
}
cat(":::::::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n### UMAP\n\n")
```

```{r, label = "report_labels_umap", fig.cap = paste0("The ", dimRedMethodToUse, " embedding coloured by labelled population."), fig.height=6, fig.width=8, eval = useLabels}
labDF <- as.data.frame(umapDFList[[umapsDFToPlot]])
labDF$population <- factor(unname(kept[as.character(labDF$cluster_id)]), levels = levels(sceLab$population))
labDF <- labDF[!is.na(labDF$population), , drop = FALSE]
coloursList$population <- setNames(catalystCols[seq_len(nlevels(sceLab$population))], levels(sceLab$population))
plotUMAPNice(df = labDF, colour_by = "population", show_density = FALSE, alpha = 0.9,
             show_cluster_labels = TRUE, cluster_labels = "population", text_size = 14) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = dr_legend_dot, alpha = 1)))
```

```{r, label = "report_labels_da_ds", results = 'asis', eval = useLabels}
cat("\n\n### DA\n\n")
for (nm in names(labDaList)) {
  cat("**", nm, "**\n\n", sep = "")
  tbl <- labDaList[[nm]][order(labDaList[[nm]]$p_adj), c("cluster_id", "logFC", "p_val", "p_adj")]
  print(knitr::kable(setNames(tbl, c("Population", "log2FC", "p", "adjusted p")), digits = 3, row.names = FALSE))

cat("### DS\n\nThe 20 population and marker pairs with the smallest adjusted p in each comparison.\n\n")

}
cat("::::::::\n\n")

```{r, label = "report_provenance_methods", results = 'asis'}
# Which implementation did the work, and whom to credit. The marmots' own R
# versions (the M methods) follow the originals but are unsupported
# fall-backs; the originals deserve the citation, and MARMOT recommends them.
.cite <- function(pkg) tryCatch(gsub("[[:space:]]+", " ", paste(format(citation(pkg)[[1]], style = "text"), collapse = " ")),
                                error = function(e) pkg)
.methods <- c(
  switch(clusteringMethodToUse,
    FlowSOM     = paste0("**Clustering:** FlowSOM. ", .cite("FlowSOM")),
    Rphenograph = paste0("**Clustering:** Rphenograph, the original PhenoGraph for R. ", .cite("Rphenograph")),
    Mphenograph = "**Clustering:** Mphenograph, the marmots' own R version of PhenoGraph (Levine et al. 2015, Cell 162:184-197), following Rphenograph (Chen and Granjeaud). It is a fall-back: not validated or peer-reviewed, and not supported. The marmots would be much happier with Rphenograph (MARMOT::install_marmot_extras() installs it); please cite the originals.",
    MfastPG     = "**Clustering:** MfastPG, the marmots' own R version of FastPG (Bodenheimer et al. 2020, https://github.com/sararselitsky/FastPG), itself based on PhenoGraph (Levine et al. 2015). It is a fall-back: not validated or peer-reviewed, and not supported. The marmots would be much happier with the originals; please cite them.",
    PARC        = "**Clustering:** PARC, the original Python implementation (Stassen et al., https://github.com/ShobiStassen/PARC).",
    Mparc       = "**Clustering:** Mparc, the marmots' own R version of PARC (Stassen et al., https://github.com/ShobiStassen/PARC). It is a fall-back: not validated or peer-reviewed, and not supported. The marmots would be much happier with the Python PARC (MARMOT::install_marmot_python() sets it up); please cite the original.",
    paste0("**Clustering:** ", clusteringMethodToUse, ".")),
  switch(dimRedMethodToUse,
    pacmap  = "**Embedding:** PaCMAP, the original Python implementation (Wang, Huang, Rudin and Shaposhnik, https://github.com/YingfanWang/PaCMAP).",
    Mpacmap = "**Embedding:** Mpacmap, the marmots' own R version of PaCMAP (Wang, Huang, Rudin and Shaposhnik, https://github.com/YingfanWang/PaCMAP). It is a fall-back: not validated or peer-reviewed, and not supported. The marmots would be much happier with the Python PaCMAP (MARMOT::install_marmot_python() sets it up); please cite the original.",
    NULL),
  paste0("**UMAP:** ", .cite("uwot")),
  paste0("**tSNE:** ", .cite("Rtsne")),
  if (exists("useBatch") && useBatch) paste0("**Batch correction:** Harmony. ", .cite("harmony")),
  paste0("**Differential abundance and state:** ", .cite("diffcyt")),
  paste0("**Data handling and many plots:** ", .cite("CATALYST")),
  "**Repeating a run:** the same data and settings gave identical results when re-run in our tests, on one computer, for FlowSOM, MfastPG, Mphenograph, Mparc, the Python PARC, UMAP, Mpacmap and the Python PaCMAP. On another computer, or with Rphenograph or tSNE (not tested), results may differ slightly."
)
cat("::: {.callout-note collapse='true' title='Methods, and whom to cite'}\n\n",
    paste0("- ", .methods, collapse = "\n"), "\n\n:::\n\n", sep = "")
```
